gold_sql:
SELECT c.caller_symbol_id
FROM code.calls c
WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IN ('auto_ontology/dal/session.py::store', 'auto_ontology/dal/session.py::write_transaction')
GROUP BY c.caller_symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.callee_symbol_id) = 2
ORDER BY c.caller_symbol_id;
